name: nussnuss
description: NussNuss 2.0: split bills with friends. Next.js web, Flutter mobile, NestJS API, Postgres.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nussnuss/core && npm run build -w @nussnuss/tokens
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @nussnuss/api && npm run build -w @nussnuss/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test -w @nussnuss/core && npm run check -w @nussnuss/tokens
